label.ar: البيانات الشكلية لعريضة افتتاح الدعوى وشروط قبولها والرسوم
label.en: Formal elements of the opening petition, conditions of admissibility and fees

question.ar: هل تبين العريضة الجهة القضائية التي ترفع أمامها الدعوى؟
question.en: Does the petition name the court before which the claim is brought?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p1 (its own slot); article 15 lists the court among the particulars.

question.ar: هل تتضمن العريضة اسم المدعي ولقبه وموطنه؟
question.en: Does the petition give the plaintiff's first name, surname and domicile?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p2 (its own slot); article 15.

question.ar: هل تتضمن العريضة اسم المدعى عليه ولقبه وموطنه، أو آخر موطن له إن لم يكن له موطن معلوم؟
question.en: Does the petition give the defendant's first name, surname and domicile, or his last domicile when none is known?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p3 (its own slot); article 15.

question.ar: هل أحد أطراف الدعوى (مدع أو مدعى عليه) شخص معنوي: شركة أو جمعية أو مؤسسة أو الدولة أو ولاية أو بلدية أو هيئة عمومية؟
question.en: Is a party (plaintiff or defendant) a legal person: a company, an association, an institution, the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public body?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p4 and document doc7 read it: article 15 asks for a legal person's name, nature, seat and representative. The existing slot public_body_party covers public bodies only.

question.ar: هل تتضمن العريضة، لكل شخص معنوي طرف في الدعوى، تسميته وطبيعته ومقره الاجتماعي وصفة ممثله القانوني أو الاتفاقي؟
question.en: Does the petition state, for each legal person that is a party, its name, its nature, its registered seat and the capacity of its legal or contractual representative?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p4 (its own slot); article 15.

question.ar: هل تتضمن العريضة عرضا موجزا للوقائع والطلبات والوسائل التي تؤسس عليها الدعوى؟
question.en: Does the petition contain a brief statement of the facts, the requests and the grounds on which the claim rests?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p5 (its own slot); article 15.

question.ar: هل تشير العريضة إلى المستندات والوثائق المؤيدة للدعوى؟
question.en: Does the petition refer to the documents that support the claim?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p6 (its own slot); article 15 asks for this reference where needed.

question.ar: هل العريضة مكتوبة وموقعة ومؤرخة؟
question.en: Is the petition in writing, signed and dated?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p7 (its own slot); article 14.

question.ar: هل أعدت نسخ من العريضة بعدد الأطراف؟
question.en: Are there copies of the petition for each party?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p8 (its own slot); article 14.

question.ar: هل العريضة محررة كلها باللغة العربية؟
question.en: Is the whole petition written in Arabic?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p19 (its own slot): article 8 paragraph 1 requires petitions in Arabic on pain of inadmissibility. Added by the verifier (attack atk-8).

question.ar: هل دفعت الرسوم القضائية المحددة قانونا عند إيداع العريضة؟
question.en: Have the judicial fees fixed by law been paid at the filing of the petition?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p9 (its own slot); article 17 registers a petition only after the fees are paid.

question.ar: هل ينص القانون على إعفاء المدعي من الرسوم في هذه القضية، كالاستفادة من المساعدة القضائية، بما فيها المساعدة الممنوحة بقوة القانون لبعض الفئات (مثل القصر الأطراف في الخصومة، والمدعي في مادة النفقة، والأم في مادة الحضانة، والعمال في مادة حوادث العمل أو الأمراض المهنية)؟
question.en: Does the law exempt the plaintiff from the fees in this case, for example through legal aid, including legal aid granted as of right to some categories (such as minors who are parties, the plaintiff in a maintenance claim, the mother in a custody claim, workers in work-accident or occupational-disease claims)?

proposedSlots.why: Exemption of prior step p9: article 17 reserves the cases where the law provides otherwise; article 417 exempts legal-aid beneficiaries. The categories named are those of the legal-aid ordinance's article 28 as printed in the Official Journal of 2009, not yet in the store (open point o14).

question.ar: هل أحد أطراف الدعوى (مدع أو مدعى عليه) قاصر، أو بالغ فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها (جنون أو عته أو سفه أو حجر)؟
question.en: Is a party (plaintiff or defendant) a minor, or an adult who lacks or has diminished capacity (insanity, imbecility, prodigality, interdiction)?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p10 and document doc7 read it: article 64 makes lack of capacity of the parties a ground of nullity the judge raises of his own motion (article 65).

question.ar: هل يتقاضى كل طرف فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها بواسطة نائبه القانوني (الولي أو الوصي أو المقدم)، مع ذكره بهذه الصفة في العريضة؟
question.en: Does every party lacking capacity sue or is sued through his legal representative (guardian, tutor or curator), named in that capacity in the petition?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p10 (its own slot); Family Code article 81.

question.ar: هل يتقدم المدعي بالدعوى بواسطة وكيل أو بواسطة ممثل قانوني أو اتفاقي لشخص معنوي (غير الولي أو الوصي أو المقدم)؟
question.en: Does the plaintiff act through an agent, or through the legal or contractual representative of a legal person (other than a guardian, tutor or curator)?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p11 and document doc7 read it: article 64 makes a representative's lack of authority a ground of nullity.

question.ar: هل للممثل أهلية وتفويض (توكيل) صحيح لتمثيل المدعي؟
question.en: Does the representative have capacity and a valid authority to act for the plaintiff?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p11 (its own slot); article 64.

question.ar: هل للمدعي صفة في رفع هذه الدعوى ضد هذا المدعى عليه؟
question.en: Does the plaintiff have standing to bring this claim against this defendant?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p12 (its own slot); article 13.

question.ar: هل للمدعي مصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون؟
question.en: Does the plaintiff have a present or potential interest recognised by law?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p13 (its own slot); article 13.

question.ar: هل يشترط القانون إذنا لرفع هذه الدعوى (كإذن القاضي للولي أو الوصي في بعض التصرفات المتعلقة بأموال القاصر)؟
question.en: Does a law require an authorisation to bring this claim (for example the judge's permission a guardian or tutor needs for certain acts on a minor's property)?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p14 and document doc6 read it: article 13 makes the judge raise of his own motion the absence of an authorisation the law requires.

question.ar: هل حصل المدعي على الإذن الذي يشترطه القانون لرفع الدعوى؟
question.en: Has the plaintiff obtained the authorisation the law requires to bring the claim?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p14 (its own slot).

question.ar: هل من بين الوثائق والمستندات المقدمة دعما للدعوى وثيقة محررة بلغة غير العربية؟
question.en: Is any of the documents filed in support of the claim written in a language other than Arabic?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p15 and document doc3 read it: article 8 requires documents in Arabic or with an official translation.

question.ar: هل أرفقت كل وثيقة محررة بلغة أجنبية بترجمة رسمية إلى اللغة العربية؟
question.en: Is every document in a foreign language accompanied by an official translation into Arabic?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p15 (its own slot); article 8.

question.ar: هل أشهرت عريضة الدعوى لدى المحافظة العقارية، أو أودعت لديها للإشهار؟
question.en: Has the petition been published at the land registry, or deposited there for publication?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p17 (its own slot): article 17 paragraph 3 requires publication of a petition concerning real property, unless its deposit for publication is proved.

question.ar: هل ترفع الدعوى أمام محكمة تجارية متخصصة منصبة (منازعات الملكية الفكرية، أو الشركات التجارية، أو التسوية القضائية والإفلاس، أو البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار، أو المنازعات البحرية والنقل الجوي والتأمينات المتعلقة بالنشاط التجاري، أو التجارة الدولية)؟
question.en: Is the claim brought before an installed specialised commercial court (intellectual property, commercial companies, judicial settlement and bankruptcy, banks and financial institutions against merchants, maritime and air transport and insurance linked to commercial activity, or international trade)?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p18 and document doc9 read it: article 536 bis 4 paragraph 3 requires the petition before that court to be accompanied by the record of non-conciliation, on pain of inadmissibility in form; article 536 bis lists its disputes and Law 22-13 article 13 ties its jurisdiction to its installation. Added by the verifier (attack adv-1).

question.ar: هل جرت محاولة الصلح أمام القاضي المعين من رئيس المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة، وأرفق محضر عدم الصلح بالعريضة؟
question.en: Was the conciliation held before the judge appointed by the president of the specialised commercial court, and is the record of non-conciliation attached to the petition?

proposedSlots.why: Prior step p18 (its own slot); article 536 bis 4 paragraphs 1 and 3.

question.ar: هل الطلاق المطلوب طلاق بالتراضي بعريضة مشتركة من الزوجين؟
question.en: Is the divorce asked for a divorce by mutual consent, by a joint petition of both spouses?

proposedSlots.why: Document doc5 and boundaries n2 and n3 read it: articles 428, 429 and 432.

question.ar: هل أحد الزوجين تحت التقديم، أو ظهر عليه اختلال في قدراته الذهنية يمنعه من التعبير عن إرادته (ويجب أن يثبت هذا الاختلال طبيب مختص)؟
question.en: Is a spouse under curatorship, or does he show a mental impairment that prevents him from expressing his will (an impairment a specialist doctor must establish)?

proposedSlots.why: Boundary n3 reads it: article 432 bars a petition for divorce by mutual consent in either case, and its second paragraph requires a specialist doctor to establish the impairment.

checklist.item: Standing and interest: no one may litigate without standing (qualité) and a present or potential interest recognised by law (CPCA art. 13 para 1).

Who raises lack of standing: the judge raises lack of standing of the plaintiff or the defendant of his own motion (CPCA art. 13 para 2); check whether interest is also raised ex officio or only on a plea.
checklist.note: Paragraph 2 names standing only. Lack of interest is a plea of inadmissibility that may be raised at any stage (article 68); the judge raises it of his own motion only if it is of public order (article 69), which the text does not settle for interest.

checklist.item: Authorisation: where a law requires an authorisation to sue (e.g. a guardian for a minor's property, a body that needs a deliberation), the judge raises its absence of his own motion (CPCA art. 13).
checklist.note: Paragraph 3 confirmed. No text in the store lists the laws that require an authorisation; Family Code article 88 is the nearest instance (judge's permission for a guardian's partition or settlement).

checklist.item: Form of the claim: the claim is brought by a written petition, signed and dated, filed at the court registry by the plaintiff, his agent or his lawyer, in as many copies as there are parties (CPCA art. 14).
Mandatory contents of the petition, on pain of formal inadmissibility (CPCA art. 15): the court seised.
Plaintiff's surname, first name and domicile (CPCA art. 15).
Defendant's surname, first name and domicile, or failing a known domicile his last known domicile (CPCA art. 15).
checklist.note: The text says «last domicile» (آخر موطن له), without «known».

checklist.item: Legal person party: its nature, name, registered seat and the capacity of its legal or contractual representative (CPCA art. 15).
A summary statement of the facts, the requests and the means (grounds) relied on (CPCA art. 15).
Mention, where needed, of the supporting documents and evidence relied on (CPCA art. 15).

Sanction of a missing element: formal inadmissibility of the petition (non-acceptance in form), not nullity; check whether it can be cured by refiling and whether the court raises it of its own motion.
checklist.note: The text says inadmissibility in form. Who raises it and whether it can be made good are not settled by the texts (open point o4).

checklist.item: Registration: the registrar enters the petition in a register, numbers it, and notes the date of the first hearing; a delay of at least twenty days between service and the first hearing, extended to three months when the defendant resides abroad (CPCA art. 16).
checklist.note: The interval runs from the delivery of the summons to the first hearing, both after registration (article 16, paragraphs 2 and 3); it is kept as statements, not as a deadline or a step, and defendant_resides_abroad is not read. Boundary case bc8 was decided by the verifier: the record is right.

checklist.item: Fees: registration of the petition requires payment of the judicial fees unless the law provides otherwise (legal aid) (CPCA art. 17 para 1).
Real-property petitions must be published at the land registry where the claim concerns rights subject to publication (CPCA art. 17) - import from land-registry-publication, do not restate.
checklist.note: Changed from derivation A's doesNotApply: article 17 paragraph 3 sits in the chapter on the opening petition and attaches inadmissibility in form to the petition itself; no module record is open to this reconciliation, so the rule is carried here as prior step p17 (warn, interpretive). If a land-registry-publication module carries the same rule, a claim should import it from a single place.

checklist.item: Service: the petition is served on the defendant by a bailiff (commissaire de justice), at the plaintiff's initiative; a copy of the petition and the summons (CPCA art. 18-19).
Language: proceedings and acts must be in Arabic, and documents in a foreign language must be accompanied by an official translation, on pain of inadmissibility (CPCA art. 8).
checklist.note: The petition's own language is now a prior step (p19, article 8 paragraph 1), added by the verifier (attack atk-8).

checklist.item: Capacity and representation: lack of capacity of a party or lack of authority of a representative is a substantive nullity that the judge may raise of his own motion and that can be cured (CPCA art. 64-66).
checklist.note: The judge must raise lack of capacity and may raise lack of authority (article 65).

checklist.item: Nullity for form of acts: no nullity without a text and proof of a grievance (CPCA art. 60).
Pleas of inadmissibility (lack of standing, lack of interest, limitation, forfeiture, res judicata) may be raised at any stage of the proceedings (CPCA art. 67-68).
Public-order inadmissibility (in particular for failure to respect time limits for remedies) must be raised by the judge of his own motion (CPCA art. 69).
Inadmissibility can be cured if its cause disappears before the judge rules (CPCA art. 67 or neighbouring article) - verify.
checklist.note: Read articles 59 to 69: the code has no cure rule for inadmissibility; cure exists for nullity only (articles 62 and 66). Not a missing text, so no request.

checklist.item: Lawyer: representation by a lawyer is not compulsory before the first-instance civil court (except where the law says so); compulsory before the administrative court (CPCA art. 826) and on appeal and cassation - verify, imports ordinary-court-exits for the administrative route.
checklist.note: Only the ordinary-court half of this line applies: article 10 names appeal and cassation, and article 14 lets the plaintiff, his agent or his lawyer file. The administrative half does not hold in the current law: Law 22-13 article 14 repealed article 826 («تلغى ... المواد 826 و835 و836 ...»), and its article 6 rewrote article 815 («ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية بعريضة ورقية أو بالطريق الإلكتروني»), which no longer names a lawyer. The administrative route belongs to ordinary-court-exits.

checklist.item: Administrative petitions: signed by a lawyer, with a copy of the contested decision attached, on pain of inadmissibility (CPCA art. 815, 819) - boundary, not this module's civil petition.
checklist.note: Only the attached decision (article 819) and the particulars of article 15 (article 816) remain of this line. The signature by a lawyer came from the Law 08-09 wording of article 815 («بعريضة موقعة من محام»); Law 22-13 rewrote article 815 («بعريضة ورقية أو بالطريق الإلكتروني») and repealed article 826. Boundary n1 rests on articles 816 and 819 only and says nothing of a lawyer.

checklist.item: Family section petitions: the family section is seised by petition under the general rules, with special provisions (CPCA art. 423-426) - verify what art. 426 adds (filing by the party in person, special documents).
checklist.note: Article 426 is territorial jurisdiction in family matters (its first paragraph: «تكون المحكمة مختصة إقليميا»), carried by the territorial-jurisdiction unit, not by this record. The petition rules are articles 436 to 438, and 428 to 432 for divorce by mutual consent.

checklist.item: Labour section: the petition must be accompanied by the record of non-conciliation (Law 90-04) - import labour-prelitigation.
checklist.note: The record attached to the petition is the labour-prelitigation module's rule; this module only records that the social section is seised by an ordinary opening petition (article 503).

checklist.item: Interest must be legitimate, personal and direct; a potential interest suffices only where the law allows (art. 13 'present or potential').
checklist.note: The text says a present or potential interest recognised by law; «personal and direct» is not in it and is not used.

checklist.item: Standing of the public prosecutor as a main party in family matters (CPCA art. 3 bis of the Family Code / art. 260 CPCA) - boundary.
checklist.note: The communication of article 260 is made at least ten days before the hearing, whose date the registrar fixes at registration (article 16): it follows the filing and is no particular or prior step of the petition (attack atk-7, refuted).

checklist.item: Legal person: standing is exercised through its legal representative; the state, wilaya and commune are represented by named officials (CPCA art. 828) - boundary to the administrative route.
checklist.note: Article 828 sits in the book on administrative courts and is not used for the ordinary petition; Law 22-13 rewrote it (it now also names national public bodies and national and regional professional organisations). Before the ordinary court a case with a public body is communicated to the prosecution (article 260).

checklist.item: Fees exemptions: legal aid (Ordinance 71-57 as amended) and statutory exemptions (workers in labour claims under Law 90-04 art. ?) - check whether in the store.
checklist.note: Law 90-04 article 25 is in the store (legal aid as of right for low-paid workers, «فضلا عن» the ordinance's own cases); the store holds the whole of Law 90-04 and no other fee article. Ordinance 71-57 is not in the store; its article 28 as rewritten by Law 09-02 (Official Journal no. 15 of 2009, page 11) grants legal aid as of right to ten categories: requested, open point o14 (grade D).

checklist.item: Documents to attach: copies of the supporting documents listed in the petition; communication of documents to the opponent (CPCA art. 21-23).
Amendment of requests: incidental and additional requests after filing (CPCA art. 25) - boundary.
Amendments: CPCA Law 08-09 (2008) amended by Law 22-13 (2022), which notably created the specialised commercial courts and touched art. 32 and following; check whether art. 13-17 were touched.
checklist.note: Law 22-13 (Official Journal no. 48 of 17 July 2022) did not touch articles 3, 8, 10, 13 to 25, 50, 60 to 69 or 417 to 438: its article 2 amends article 33 only among the first book's articles (page 3), and the amendment ledger lists no other change to them; the store gives them in their Law 08-09 wording. It rewrote articles 815 and 828 and repealed 826, on which checklist lines k22, k23 and k28 (not statements) rest: see their notes. It inserted article 536 bis 4 (conciliation before the specialised commercial court), now carried by b59, b60 and p18.

checklist.item: What looks like a defect in the petition and is not: territorial incompetence (imported territorial-jurisdiction), the wrong section (imported court-sections), lack of formal notice (imported formal-notice) - each has its own sanction.
checklist.note: Territory, section and formal notice each belong to their own module; not restated. Procedural pleas must be raised together before the merits (article 50). The record of non-conciliation before the specialised commercial court is not one of these: article 536 bis 4 paragraph 3 attaches inadmissibility in form to the petition that lacks it, so it is carried here (p18).

checklist.item: The 22 Legal Review questions: each mandatory field of the form (court, parties, legal person representative, facts, requests, means, documents, signature, date, place) must map to an article and a sanction.
checklist.note: Court, parties, legal person, facts, requests, grounds and documents: article 15 with formal inadmissibility (p1 to p6). Signature, date and copies: article 14, no stated sanction (p7, p8, o1). Language of the petition: article 8 with inadmissibility (p19). Place of drafting: no text found in the store.

checklist.item: Does the plaintiff have capacity to sue (full civil capacity, or a legal representative)?
checklist.note: The age of capacity is not in the store (k67).

checklist.item: Does the plaintiff have standing (a personal right or legal position at stake)?
Does the plaintiff have a legitimate interest, existing or at least potential?
Does the court raise lack of standing or of interest of its own motion, or only on a party's objection?
checklist.note: Standing and authorisation are raised of the judge's own motion; the plea of inadmissibility may be made at any stage; the judge raises it of his own motion when of public order.

checklist.item: Is the petition in writing, in Arabic, signed by the plaintiff or his lawyer, and dated?
Is the petition filed at the court registry with enough copies for the defendants?
Does the petition name the court that will hear it?
Does the petition give the plaintiff's surname, first name and domicile?
Does the petition give the defendant's surname, first name and domicile, or his last known domicile?
For a legal person, does the petition give its nature, name, registered seat and its representative?
Does the petition give a brief statement of the facts?
Does the petition state the claims (what is asked of the court) and the grounds relied on?
Does the petition list the documents and evidence attached to it?
Are the supporting documents attached in the right number of copies?
checklist.note: The text asks for originals, official copies or certified true copies, not a number of copies; the judge may accept ordinary copies (article 21 paragraph 2); the copies of the petition itself are doc1.

checklist.item: What is the consequence if a mandatory element is missing: inadmissibility, a request to regularise, or nothing?
Can the defect be cured later, and until when?
checklist.note: The correction articles speak of nullity; whether they reach a missing particular is open point o4.

checklist.item: Is the petition registered by the registry only after the judicial fees are paid?
What fee is due at filing, and who is exempt (legal aid, the State, certain matters)?
checklist.note: Searched the store's cpca articles 13 to 17 and 417 to 419 and the words الرسوم and المساعدة القضائية in all codes: no tariff, and no exemption text beyond legal aid (article 417) and Law 90-04 article 25. Outside the store, the Official Journal no. 15 of 2009 (page 11) prints article 28 of the legal-aid ordinance as rewritten by Law 09-02: legal aid as of right to ten categories; requested (open point o14, grade D). No tariff text was found.

checklist.item: What happens if the fee is not paid: refusal to register, a time to pay, or inadmissibility?
Does the petition have to state the date of the first hearing and the summons period?
checklist.note: The registrar writes the case number and the hearing date; the petition itself does not state them.

checklist.item: Is a lawyer mandatory before this court or this kind of claim?
Must the petition cite the legal text relied on?
checklist.note: The list of particulars asks for the facts, the requests and the grounds; no paragraph asks for the legal text to be cited.

checklist.item: Must the petition state the amount claimed when it is a money claim?
checklist.note: No paragraph of the list of particulars asks for an amount; the value of the dispute is fixed by the requests (article 25). Amounts are handled by the accessory-requests and proof modules.

checklist.item: Does a joinder of several claims or several defendants change the petition's form?
checklist.note: The petition has as many copies as there are parties (article 14); no other change of form is stated.

checklist.item: Does the family-matters section require anything more in the petition (the conciliation, the public prosecutor)?
checklist.note: The conciliation attempts of articles 439 to 443 are held by the judge after filing (article 442 paragraph 2 counts from the filing of the divorce claim), so they are no step before the petition; they belong to the conciliation-mediation module.

checklist.item: Is a petition lodged by a person without standing void or only inadmissible?
checklist.note: The plea of inadmissibility covers lack of standing; the nullity article lists capacity, not standing.

checklist.item: Does the interest have to exist at filing, or may it arise later?
checklist.note: The text accepts an interest present or potential; it says nothing of one arising later.

checklist.item: Can a third party intervene or be called in, and how must that request be made?
Which prior steps must be shown with the petition (notice, conciliation record, publication)?
checklist.note: Publication of a petition on real property (p17) and the record of non-conciliation before the specialised commercial court (p18, article 536 bis 4 paragraph 3) are carried here, because both texts attach inadmissibility in form to the petition itself. Formal notice, labour conciliation and mediation belong to their own modules. If a commercial-conciliation module carries the same rule as p18, a claim must import it from one place only.

checklist.item: Does the petition interrupt a limitation period by being filed, and from what date?
checklist.note: Carried by the periods module; no article of this unit speaks of it.

checklist.item: The store carries a note on every Family Code article cited (current snapshot at a 2026-10-26 cut-off; commencement by local receipt; date-based lookup fail-closed): from which date does the cited wording apply, and what does that change for this unit?
checklist.note: Articles 81 and 88 are cited in their Law 84-11 wording and article 3 bis in its Ordinance 05-02 wording. The note certifies the current snapshot only and gives no commencement date for earlier cases. For this unit the cited paragraphs serve representation of an incapable party (p10), the prosecution's copy (doc8, o7) and an instance of authorisation (o2); none is a deadline, so the date matters only for a case whose facts predate Ordinance 05-02 (article 3 bis did not exist before it). The record follows the current wording; the lawyer checks the wording in force for an older case.

checklist.item: Legal aid ordinance (Ordinance 71-57) for the conditions of the fee exemption.
checklist.note: Searched the store's text views for المساعدة القضائية: only CPCA 79, 356, 357, 417, 832 and Law 90-04 article 25 mention it; the ordinance itself is absent. The verifier found its article 28, as rewritten by Law 09-02, in the Official Journal no. 15 of 8 March 2009, page 11 (legal aid as of right to ten categories); requested in requests.jsonl, open point o14 (grade D) until it is in the store.

checklist.item: Civil Code articles on capacity (age of majority, discernment, representation of a person of limited capacity).
checklist.note: The store's civil-code view has no articles 40 to 51.

checklist.item: Legislation fixing the judicial fees and their statutory exemptions.
checklist.note: Searched the store for الرسوم القضائية and الرسم القضائي: only procedural references (CPCA 17, 242, 742, 821, 825). Legal aid as of right: see k66 and o14.

checklist.item: Does the store carry a note on a cited article of the code of civil and administrative procedure (a date from which a wording applies)?
checklist.note: Articles 3 to 503 and 816, 819 cited here carry no entry-into-force note. Article 536 bis 4 (b59, b60) and article 536 bis (b61) carry the Law 22-13 note, answered in k77. Notes also sit on articles 32, 815, 826 and 828, which are not cited.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 7 paragraph 1 (public hearings, unless publicity harms public order, morals or the family).
checklist.note: Article 7 governs the publicity of hearings, not the language or the contents of the petition; it gives no exception to article 8.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 419 paragraph 1 (the losing party bears the costs).
checklist.note: Who bears the costs at the end of the case is an accessory request (accessory-requests module), not a formal element of the petition or a condition of its registration.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 260 paragraph 10 (the prosecution may examine any other case).
checklist.note: A power of the prosecution, not a duty of the plaintiff; it adds nothing the petition must contain.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 2 paragraph 1 (immediate application, except periods already running under the old law).
checklist.note: A transitional rule of the 2008 code; this record has no period, and the cited wordings are all in force.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 194 paragraph 4 (no intervention before the court of remand after cassation, unless the remand decision says otherwise).
checklist.note: Concerns intervention after cassation; the opening petition before the first-instance court is not affected.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 195 paragraph 1 (intervention only if sufficiently linked to the parties' claims).
checklist.note: A condition of admissibility of an intervention, not of the opening petition; kept outside this record.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: cpca 425 paragraph 1 (powers of the president of the family section).
checklist.note: The judge's powers of inquiry in family matters; nothing on the petition. Its neighbour article 426 (territory) is not carried here either.

checklist.item: The store carries a note on cpca 536 bis and 536 bis 4 (Law 22-13 sets no calendar commencement; its article 13 defers the new jurisdiction rules to the installation of the new courts and keeps earlier-filed cases with the former courts): what does it change for this unit?
checklist.note: Article 536 bis 4 sits in the section on the specialised commercial court, and that court hears its disputes only once installed (Law 22-13 article 13 paragraph 1); cases filed before the installation stay with the former courts (paragraph 2). The installation dates are not in the store, so p18 does not infer them: it asks whether the claim is brought before an installed specialised commercial court, and applies only then.

says.ar: لا يجوز التقاضي إلا لمن له صفة ومصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون.
says.en: No person may litigate without standing and a present or potential interest recognised by law.

says.ar: يثير القاضي من تلقاء نفسه انعدام الصفة في المدعي أو في المدعى عليه.
says.en: The judge raises of his own motion the lack of standing of the plaintiff or of the defendant.

says.ar: يثير القاضي من تلقاء نفسه انعدام الإذن متى اشترطه القانون.
says.en: The judge also raises of his own motion the absence of an authorisation where the law requires it.

says.ar: ترفع الدعوى بعريضة مكتوبة موقعة ومؤرخة، يودعها المدعي أو وكيله أو محاميه بأمانة الضبط، بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف.
says.en: A claim is brought by a written petition, signed and dated, filed at the registry by the plaintiff, his agent or his lawyer, in as many copies as there are parties.

says.ar: يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى البيانات المعددة، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا.
says.en: The opening petition must contain the listed particulars, on pain of being held inadmissible in form.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة الجهة القضائية التي ترفع أمامها الدعوى.
says.en: Among the particulars: the court before which the claim is brought.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة اسم المدعي ولقبه وموطنه.
says.en: Among the particulars: the plaintiff's first name, surname and domicile.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة اسم المدعى عليه ولقبه وموطنه، فإن لم يكن له موطن معلوم فآخر موطن له.
says.en: Among the particulars: the defendant's first name, surname and domicile, or failing a known domicile, his last domicile.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة تسمية الشخص المعنوي وطبيعته ومقره الاجتماعي وصفة ممثله القانوني أو الاتفاقي.
says.en: Among the particulars: for a legal person, its name, its nature, its registered seat and the capacity of its legal or contractual representative.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة عرض موجز للوقائع والطلبات والوسائل التي تؤسس عليها الدعوى.
says.en: Among the particulars: a brief statement of the facts, the requests and the grounds on which the claim rests.

says.ar: من بيانات العريضة الإشارة، عند الاقتضاء، إلى المستندات والوثائق المؤيدة للدعوى.
says.en: Among the particulars: where needed, a reference to the documents and papers supporting the claim.

says.ar: تقيد العريضة حالا في سجل خاص، ويسجل أمين الضبط رقم القضية وتاريخ أول جلسة على نسخها ويسلمها للمدعي لتبليغها رسميا للخصوم.
says.en: The petition is entered at once in a special register; the registrar writes the case number and the first hearing date on its copies and hands them to the plaintiff for formal service on the other parties.

says.ar: يجب أن يفصل عشرون يوما على الأقل بين تسليم التكليف بالحضور وتاريخ أول جلسة، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
says.en: At least twenty days must separate the delivery of the summons and the first hearing, unless the law provides otherwise.

says.ar: يمدد هذا الأجل أمام جميع الجهات القضائية إلى ثلاثة أشهر إذا كان المكلف بالحضور مقيما في الخارج.
says.en: That interval is extended before all courts to three months when the person summoned resides abroad.

says.ar: لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
says.en: The petition is entered in the register only after the fees fixed by law are paid, unless the law provides otherwise.

says.ar: يفصل رئيس الجهة القضائية في كل نزاع حول دفع الرسوم بأمر غير قابل لأي طعن.
says.en: The president of the court decides any dispute over the payment of fees by an order open to no remedy.

says.ar: تشهر عريضة الدعوى المتعلقة بعقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر لدى المحافظة العقارية وتقدم في أول جلسة، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار.
says.en: A petition concerning real property or a real right in it that is published under the law must be published at the land registry and produced at the first hearing, on pain of inadmissibility in form, unless its deposit for publication is proved.

basis.interpretiveNote: The word «مشهر» may qualify only the real right or both the property and the right («بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر»); the Arabic does not settle which, so whether the duty reaches real property that is not itself published is a reading. The store carries no French check of this article.

says.ar: تحرر الإجراءات والعقود القضائية، ومنها العرائض والمذكرات، باللغة العربية تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
says.en: Judicial procedures and acts, petitions and briefs included, are made in Arabic on pain of inadmissibility.

says.ar: تقدم الوثائق والمستندات باللغة العربية أو مصحوبة بترجمة رسمية إليها، تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
says.en: Documents and papers are filed in Arabic or with an official translation into Arabic, on pain of inadmissibility.

says.ar: تمثيل الخصوم بمحام وجوبي أمام جهات الاستئناف والنقض، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
says.en: Representation by a lawyer is compulsory before the appeal and cassation courts, unless the law provides otherwise.

basis.interpretiveNote: The paragraph names only appeal and cassation; that representation is optional before the first-instance court is read from that silence and from the article on filing, which lets the plaintiff file himself. Other laws not in the store may require a lawyer in some matters.

says.ar: من الحالات الحصرية لبطلان الإجراءات من حيث موضوعها انعدام أهلية الخصوم.
says.en: Lack of capacity of the parties is among the exhaustive grounds of substantive nullity of procedures.

says.ar: ومن هذه الحالات انعدام الأهلية أو التفويض لدى ممثل الشخص الطبيعي أو المعنوي.
says.en: Another such ground is the lack of capacity or of authority of the representative of a natural or legal person.

says.ar: يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الأهلية، ويجوز له أن يثير تلقائيا انعدام التفويض لدى الممثل.
says.en: The judge raises lack of capacity of his own motion, and may raise of his own motion a representative's lack of authority.

says.ar: لا يقضى ببطلان إجراء قابل للتصحيح إذا زال سببه بإجراء لاحق أثناء الخصومة.
says.en: A correctable procedure is not annulled if the cause of nullity is removed by a later step during the proceedings.

says.ar: يجوز للقاضي منح أجل لتصحيح الإجراء المشوب بالبطلان إذا لم يبق ضرر بعد التصحيح، ويسري التصحيح من تاريخ الإجراء.
says.en: The judge may grant time to correct a procedure tainted with nullity if no harm remains after correction; the correction takes effect from the date of the procedure.

says.ar: لا يقرر بطلان الأعمال الإجرائية شكلا إلا بنص صريح، وعلى المتمسك به إثبات الضرر.
says.en: Procedural acts are not annulled for form unless a text expressly says so, and whoever invokes the nullity must prove the harm he suffered.

says.ar: الدفع بعدم القبول يرمي إلى عدم قبول الطلب لانعدام الحق في التقاضي، كانعدام الصفة أو المصلحة أو التقادم أو انقضاء الأجل المسقط أو حجية الشيء المقضي فيه، دون النظر في الموضوع.
says.en: A plea of inadmissibility seeks to have a claim declared inadmissible for want of a right to sue, such as lack of standing or of interest, limitation, forfeiture or res judicata, without examining the merits.

says.ar: يجوز تقديم الدفع بعدم القبول في أية مرحلة من الدعوى ولو بعد الدفاع في الموضوع.
says.en: A plea of inadmissibility may be raised at any stage, even after defences on the merits.

says.ar: يثير القاضي تلقائيا الدفع بعدم القبول إذا كان من النظام العام.
says.en: The judge must raise of his own motion a plea of inadmissibility that is of public order.

says.ar: يعفى المستفيد من المساعدة القضائية من دفع المصاريف القضائية.
says.en: A beneficiary of legal aid is exempt from paying judicial costs.

says.ar: تشمل المصاريف القضائية الرسوم المستحقة للدولة ومصاريف سير الدعوى كما يحددها التشريع.
says.en: Judicial costs include the fees owed to the State and the costs of the proceedings, as legislation fixes them.

says.ar: يستفيد بقوة القانون من المساعدة القضائية كل عامل أو متمهن يقل أجره عن ضعف الأجر الوطني الأدنى المضمون.
says.en: Every worker or apprentice whose pay is below twice the guaranteed minimum wage is entitled to legal aid as of right.

basis.interpretiveNote: The store's text reads «يقبل مرتبه عن ضعف»; the record reads «يقبل» as «يقل» (is below), the only sense the sentence admits. Its opening words «فضلا عن الاحكام المنصوص عليها بموجب الامر رقم 71 – 57» make it an addition to the legal-aid ordinance's own cases, whose article 28 is not in the store (open point o14).

says.ar: تودع الوثائق التي يستند إليها الخصوم بأمانة الضبط بأصولها أو بنسخ رسمية أو مطابقة للأصل، وتبلغ للخصم.
says.en: The papers relied on are filed at the registry as originals, official copies or certified copies, and communicated to the opponent.

says.ar: تقدم المستندات إلى أمين الضبط لجردها والتأشير عليها قبل إيداعها بالملف، تحت طائلة الرفض.
says.en: The documents are handed to the registrar for inventory and endorsement before they are placed in the file, on pain of rejection.

says.ar: يتم إيداع المستندات بأمانة الضبط مقابل وصل استلام.
says.en: The documents are deposited at the registry against a receipt.

says.ar: ينوب قانونا عن فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها لصغر السن أو جنون أو عته أو سفه ولي أو وصي أو مقدم.
says.en: A person who lacks or has diminished capacity because of minority, insanity, imbecility or prodigality is represented by law by a guardian, a tutor or a curator.

says.ar: يقدم طلب الطلاق باسم الزوج ناقص الأهلية من قبل وليه أو مقدمه.
says.en: A divorce request by a spouse of diminished capacity is made in his name by his guardian or curator.

says.ar: ترفع دعوى الطلاق من أحد الزوجين أمام قسم شؤون الأسرة بعريضة وفق الأشكال المقررة لرفع الدعوى.
says.en: A divorce claim by a single spouse is brought before the family section by a petition in the forms laid down for bringing a claim.

says.ar: على المدعي في دعوى الطلاق أن يبلغ رسميا المدعى عليه والنيابة العامة بنسخة من العريضة.
says.en: The plaintiff in a divorce claim must formally serve a copy of the petition on the defendant and on the public prosecution.

says.ar: يجوز تبليغ النيابة العامة عن طريق أمانة الضبط.
says.en: The public prosecution may also be notified through the registry.

says.ar: النيابة العامة طرف أصلي في جميع القضايا الرامية إلى تطبيق قانون الأسرة.
says.en: The public prosecution is a principal party in every case that seeks the application of the Family Code.

says.ar: ترفع الدعوى أمام القسم الاجتماعي بعريضة افتتاح دعوى طبقا للقواعد المقررة قانونا.
says.en: A claim before the social section is brought by an opening petition under the rules laid down by law.

says.ar: يجب أن تتضمن عريضة افتتاح الدعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية البيانات المقررة لعريضة الدعوى أمام المحكمة.
says.en: A petition before the administrative court must contain the particulars required of an opening petition before the ordinary court.

says.ar: ترفق بالعريضة الرامية إلى إلغاء القرار الإداري أو تفسيره أو فحص مشروعيته نسخة من القرار المطعون فيه، تحت طائلة عدم القبول ما لم يوجد مانع مبرر.
says.en: A petition to annul, interpret or review the legality of an administrative decision must attach the contested decision, on pain of inadmissibility, unless there is a justified impediment.

says.ar: يقدم طلب الطلاق بالتراضي في عريضة وحيدة موقعة من الزوجين.
says.en: Divorce by mutual consent is requested by a single joint petition signed by both spouses.

says.ar: تتضمن العريضة الوحيدة الجهة القضائية وبيانات الزوجين وتاريخ ومكان الزواج، وعند الاقتضاء عدد الأولاد القصر، وعرضا موجزا يتضمن جميع شروط اتفاقهما على توابع الطلاق.
says.en: The single petition gives the court, the spouses' particulars, the date and place of the marriage, where applicable the number of minor children, and a brief statement of all the terms of their agreement on the consequences of divorce.

says.ar: يرفق بالعريضة الوحيدة شهادة عائلية ومستخرج من عقد الزواج.
says.en: A family certificate and an extract of the marriage deed are attached to the single petition.

says.ar: لا يقدم طلب الطلاق بالتراضي إذا كان أحد الزوجين تحت التقديم أو ظهر عليه اختلال في قدراته الذهنية يمنعه من التعبير عن إرادته، ويثبت الاختلال طبيب مختص.
says.en: A request for divorce by mutual consent may not be made where a spouse is under curatorship or shows a mental impairment that prevents him from expressing his will, which a specialist doctor must establish.

says.ar: يتحدد موضوع النزاع بالادعاءات الواردة في عريضة افتتاح الدعوى ومذكرات الرد.
says.en: The subject of the dispute is fixed by the claims made in the opening petition and in the replies.

says.ar: يمكن تعديل موضوع النزاع بطلبات عارضة مرتبطة بالادعاءات الأصلية.
says.en: The subject of the dispute may be changed by incidental requests linked to the original claims.

says.ar: يجب إبلاغ النيابة العامة قبل الجلسة بعشرة أيام على الأقل بالقضايا التي تكون الدولة أو جماعة إقليمية أو مؤسسة عمومية إدارية طرفا فيها، وبقضايا حماية ناقصي الأهلية.
says.en: The public prosecution must be informed at least ten days before the hearing of cases to which the State, a territorial authority or a public administrative body is a party, and of cases on the protection of persons lacking capacity.

says.ar: على الولي أن يستأذن القاضي في بيع عقار القاصر وقسمته ورهنه وإجراء المصالحة.
says.en: A guardian must obtain the judge's permission to sell, partition or mortgage the minor's real property and to make a settlement.

says.ar: لكل شخص يدعي حقا أن يرفع دعوى للحصول عليه أو حمايته.
says.en: Anyone who claims a right may bring a claim to obtain or protect it.

says.ar: تثار الدفوع الشكلية في آن واحد قبل أي دفاع في الموضوع أو دفع بعدم القبول، تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
says.en: Procedural pleas are raised together before any defence on the merits or plea of inadmissibility, on pain of being inadmissible.

says.ar: يسلم المحضر القضائي التكليف بالحضور للخصوم مرفقا بنسخة من العريضة مؤشر عليها من أمين الضبط.
says.en: The bailiff delivers the summons to the parties together with a copy of the petition endorsed by the registrar.

says.ar: لا يقبل التدخل إلا ممن توفرت فيه الصفة والمصلحة.
says.en: Intervention is admitted only from a person who has standing and interest.

says.ar: يتم التدخل وفق الإجراءات المقررة لرفع الدعوى.
says.en: Intervention follows the procedure laid down for bringing a claim.

says.ar: يجوز للقاضي قبول نسخ عادية من الوثائق عند الاقتضاء.
says.en: The judge may, where needed, accept ordinary copies of the papers.

says.ar: في حالة فشل محاولة الصلح ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بعريضة افتتاح دعوى مرفقة بمحضر عدم الصلح، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا.
says.en: When the conciliation fails, the claim is brought before the specialised commercial court by an opening petition accompanied by the record of non-conciliation, on pain of the claim being inadmissible in form.

says.ar: يسبق قيد الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة إجراء صلح يطلبه أحد الخصوم من رئيس المحكمة، الذي يعين أحد القضاة لإجرائه.
says.en: Registration of the claim before the specialised commercial court is preceded by a conciliation, requested by a party from the court's president, who appoints a judge to hold it.

says.ar: تختص المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بمنازعات الملكية الفكرية والشركات التجارية والتسوية القضائية والإفلاس ومنازعات البنوك والمؤسسات المالية مع التجار والمنازعات البحرية والنقل الجوي والتأمينات المتعلقة بالنشاط التجاري والتجارة الدولية.
says.en: The specialised commercial court hears disputes on intellectual property, commercial companies, judicial settlement and bankruptcy, banks and financial institutions against merchants, maritime and air transport and insurance linked to commercial activity, and international trade.

says.ar: تسري قواعد الاختصاص النوعي والإقليمي الخاصة بالمحاكم التجارية المتخصصة ابتداء من تاريخ تنصيب الجهات القضائية الجديدة.
says.en: The subject-matter and territorial jurisdiction rules of the specialised commercial courts apply from the date the new courts are installed.

toProve.ar: أن للمدعي صفة في رفع الدعوى ومصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون.
toProve.en: That the plaintiff has standing to bring the claim and a present or potential interest recognised by law.

factsToState.ar: الصلة التي تربط المدعي بالحق المطالب به (مالكه، دائنه، وارثه، نائب قانوني عنه…).
factsToState.en: The link between the plaintiff and the right claimed (its owner, its creditor, an heir, its legal representative…).

factsToState.ar: الصلة التي تجعل المدعى عليه هو الملزم بالحق أو المتعرض له.
factsToState.en: The link that makes the defendant the person bound by, or interfering with, the right.

name.en: Copies of the petition, as many as there are parties

why.ar: تودع العريضة بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف، ويسلم أمين الضبط نسخها المؤشر عليها للمدعي لتبليغها مع التكليف بالحضور.
why.en: The petition is filed in as many copies as there are parties; the registrar returns the endorsed copies to the plaintiff, to be served with the summons.

name.ar: المستندات والوثائق المؤيدة للدعوى، بأصولها أو بنسخ رسمية أو مطابقة للأصل، مع جرد يؤشر عليه أمين الضبط
name.en: Supporting documents, as originals, official or certified copies, with an inventory endorsed by the registrar

why.ar: تشير العريضة إلى المستندات المؤيدة، وتودع هذه بأمانة الضبط بعد جردها والتأشير عليها تحت طائلة الرفض، مقابل وصل استلام؛ ويجوز للقاضي قبول نسخ عادية عند الاقتضاء.
why.en: The petition refers to the supporting documents, which are filed at the registry after inventory and endorsement, on pain of rejection, against a receipt; the judge may accept ordinary copies where needed.

name.ar: ترجمة رسمية إلى العربية لكل وثيقة محررة بلغة أجنبية
name.en: An official Arabic translation of every document in a foreign language

why.ar: تقدم الوثائق باللغة العربية أو مصحوبة بترجمة رسمية، تحت طائلة عدم القبول.
why.en: Documents are filed in Arabic or with an official translation, on pain of inadmissibility.

name.ar: وصل دفع الرسوم القضائية، أو ما يثبت الاستفادة من المساعدة القضائية (ومنها المساعدة الممنوحة بقوة القانون) أو الإعفاء القانوني
name.en: Receipt for the judicial fees, or proof of legal aid (legal aid as of right included) or of a statutory exemption

why.ar: لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك، ويعفى المستفيد من المساعدة القضائية من المصاريف.
why.en: The petition is registered only after the fees fixed by law are paid, unless the law provides otherwise; a legal-aid beneficiary is exempt from costs.

name.ar: شهادة عائلية ومستخرج من عقد زواج الزوجين
name.en: Family certificate and extract of the spouses' marriage deed

why.ar: يرفقان بالعريضة الوحيدة في الطلاق بالتراضي.
why.en: They are attached to the single petition for divorce by mutual consent.

name.ar: الإذن الذي يشترطه القانون لرفع الدعوى
name.en: The authorisation the law requires to bring the claim

why.ar: يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الإذن إذا اشترطه القانون.
why.en: The judge raises of his own motion the absence of an authorisation the law requires.

name.ar: ما يثبت صفة الممثل وتفويضه (القانون الأساسي أو محضر التعيين أو الوكالة أو حكم أو عقد الولاية أو الوصاية أو التقديم)
name.en: Proof of the representative's capacity and authority (articles of association or appointment record, power of attorney, or the judgment or deed of guardianship, tutorship or curatorship)

why.ar: انعدام الأهلية أو التفويض لدى ممثل الشخص الطبيعي أو المعنوي سبب لبطلان الإجراءات، ويجوز للقاضي إثارته تلقائيا.
why.en: A representative's lack of capacity or authority makes the procedure null, and the judge may raise it of his own motion.

name.ar: نسخة من عريضة الطلاق لتبليغها إلى المدعى عليه وإلى النيابة العامة
name.en: A copy of the divorce petition for service on the defendant and on the public prosecution

why.ar: على المدعي في دعوى الطلاق المرفوعة من أحد الزوجين أن يبلغ رسميا المدعى عليه والنيابة العامة بنسخة من العريضة بعد قيدها، ويجوز تبليغ النيابة عن طريق أمانة الضبط. (يدرج التطليق والخلع هنا على أنهما طلب طلاق من أحد الزوجين، وهي قراءة.)
why.en: The plaintiff in a divorce claim by a single spouse must formally serve a copy of the petition, once registered, on the defendant and on the public prosecution, which may be done through the registry. (Tatliq and khul are included as divorce requested by a single spouse; that is a reading.)

name.ar: محضر عدم الصلح المحرر أمام القاضي المعين من رئيس المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة
name.en: The record of non-conciliation drawn up before the judge appointed by the president of the specialised commercial court

why.ar: يسبق قيد الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة إجراء الصلح، وفي حالة فشله ترفع الدعوى بعريضة مرفقة بمحضر عدم الصلح، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا.
why.en: Registration of a claim before the specialised commercial court is preceded by a conciliation; when it fails, the petition must be accompanied by the record of non-conciliation, on pain of the claim being inadmissible in form.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب أن تبين العريضة الجهة القضائية التي ترفع أمامها الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا. تحقق من ذكرها.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition must name the court before which the claim is brought, on pain of inadmissibility in form. Check that it is named.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب أن تتضمن العريضة اسم المدعي ولقبه وموطنه، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا. تحقق من ذلك.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition must give the plaintiff's first name, surname and domicile, on pain of inadmissibility in form. Check them.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب أن تتضمن العريضة اسم المدعى عليه ولقبه وموطنه، فإن لم يكن له موطن معلوم فآخر موطن له، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا. تحقق من ذلك.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition must give the defendant's first name, surname and domicile, or his last domicile if none is known, on pain of inadmissibility in form. Check them.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: إذا كان أحد الأطراف شخصا معنويا وجب أن تتضمن العريضة تسميته وطبيعته ومقره الاجتماعي وصفة ممثله القانوني أو الاتفاقي، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا. تحقق من ورود هذه البيانات لكل شخص معنوي طرف في الدعوى.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: where a party is a legal person, the petition must state its name, nature, registered seat and the capacity of its legal or contractual representative, on pain of inadmissibility in form. Check these particulars for every legal person that is a party.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب أن تتضمن العريضة عرضا موجزا للوقائع والطلبات والوسائل التي تؤسس عليها الدعوى، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا. تحقق من ذلك.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition must contain a brief statement of the facts, the requests and the grounds on which the claim rests, on pain of inadmissibility in form. Check it.

message.ar: المادة 15 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: تشير العريضة، عند الاقتضاء، إلى المستندات والوثائق المؤيدة للدعوى. تحقق من الإشارة إليها إذا كانت الدعوى تستند إلى وثائق.
message.en: Article 15 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition refers, where needed, to the supporting documents. Check that they are referred to when the claim relies on documents.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The paragraph asks for the reference only «عند الاقتضاء» (where needed), so a missing reference is not always a defect; whether the sanction of the first paragraph reaches it depends on whether the claim relies on documents, which the text leaves to the case. The protective reading is to warn.

message.ar: المادة 14 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: ترفع الدعوى بعريضة مكتوبة موقعة ومؤرخة. تحقق من التوقيع والتاريخ.
message.en: Article 14 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the claim is brought by a written, signed and dated petition. Check the signature and the date.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 14 states the form (written, signed, dated) and no sanction; article 60 allows no nullity for form without an express text, and the formal inadmissibility of article 15 attaches to the particulars it lists. Whether an unsigned or undated petition is inadmissible is a reading; the rule warns.

message.ar: المادة 14 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: تودع العريضة بعدد من النسخ يساوي عدد الأطراف. تحقق من عدد النسخ.
message.en: Article 14 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition is filed in as many copies as there are parties. Check the number of copies.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 14 asks for as many copies as there are parties and states no sanction; article 60 allows no nullity for form without an express text. The rule warns.

note.ar: يحتفظ النص بالحالات التي ينص فيها القانون على خلاف ذلك، ومنها المساعدة القضائية، بما فيها المساعدة الممنوحة بقوة القانون.
note.en: The text reserves the cases where the law provides otherwise, legal aid among them, legal aid as of right included.

message.ar: المادة 17 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: لا تقيد العريضة إلا بعد دفع الرسوم المحددة قانونا، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك؛ والمادة 417: يعفى المستفيد من المساعدة القضائية من المصاريف. تحقق من الدفع أو من سبب الإعفاء.
message.en: Article 17 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the petition is registered only after the fees fixed by law are paid, unless the law provides otherwise; article 417: a legal-aid beneficiary is exempt from costs. Check the payment or the ground of exemption.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The stated consequence of non-payment is that the petition is not registered; inadmissibility is not stated. The fees are paid at the filing, after the draft is written. Fee amounts are not in the store. Legal aid granted as of right by the legal-aid ordinance (its article 28 as printed in the Official Journal of 2009: among others minors who are parties, the plaintiff in maintenance, the mother in custody) is not yet in the store (open point o14): the exemption is asked, never assumed from the requests.

message.ar: المادتان 64 و65 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية والمادة 81 من قانون الأسرة: انعدام أهلية الخصوم سبب لبطلان الإجراءات يثيره القاضي تلقائيا، وينوب عن فاقد الأهلية أو ناقصها لصغر السن أو جنون أو عته أو سفه وليه أو وصيه أو مقدمه. تحقق من أن كل طرف معني، مدعيا كان أو مدعى عليه، يتقاضى بواسطة نائبه القانوني المذكور بصفته في العريضة.
message.en: Articles 64 and 65 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure and article 81 of the Family Code: a party's lack of capacity makes the procedure null and the judge raises it of his own motion; a person lacking capacity, or of diminished capacity, because of minority, insanity, imbecility or prodigality is represented by his guardian, tutor or curator. Check that every such party, plaintiff or defendant, sues or is sued through that representative, named in that capacity in the petition.

message.ar: المادتان 64 و65 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: انعدام أهلية ممثل الشخص الطبيعي أو المعنوي أو انعدام تفويضه سبب لبطلان الإجراءات، ويجوز للقاضي إثارته تلقائيا. تحقق من الوكالة أو من سند صفة الممثل.
message.en: Articles 64 and 65 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: a representative's lack of capacity or authority makes the procedure null, and the judge may raise it of his own motion. Check the power of attorney or the representative's title.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Article 64 makes a representative's lack of authority a ground of nullity, but article 65 only allows (يجوز) the judge to raise it, and articles 62 and 66 let a correctable defect be cured during the proceedings; whether the defect leaves the petition null is a reading. The rule warns.

message.ar: المادة 13 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: لا يجوز التقاضي ما لم تكن للمدعي صفة، ويثير القاضي انعدامها تلقائيا. تحقق من صفة المدعي تجاه المدعى عليه.
message.en: Article 13 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: a person may sue only with standing, and the judge raises its absence of his own motion. Check the plaintiff's standing against this defendant.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The texts make lack of standing a ground of inadmissibility raised by the judge, but say nothing of what the petition must show; whether the plaintiff has standing is a legal assessment the lawyer makes. The rule warns.

message.ar: المادة 13 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يشترط في المدعي مصلحة قائمة أو محتملة يقرها القانون. تحقق من المصلحة.
message.en: Article 13 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the plaintiff must have a present or potential interest recognised by law. Check the interest.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Lack of interest is a ground of inadmissibility (article 67); whether an interest exists is a legal assessment, and whether the judge raises it of his own motion depends on whether it is of public order (article 69), which the texts do not settle. The rule warns.

message.ar: المادة 13 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يثير القاضي تلقائيا انعدام الإذن إذا اشترطه القانون. تحقق من الحصول على الإذن قبل رفع الدعوى.
message.en: Article 13 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: the judge raises of his own motion the absence of an authorisation the law requires. Check that the authorisation was obtained before filing.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The paragraph tells the judge to raise the missing authorisation and states no sanction; that the sanction is inadmissibility rests on the chapter heading (conditions of admissibility) and on the open list of pleas of inadmissibility. Which laws require an authorisation is not listed in the code. Nor does the paragraph say when the authorisation must exist: at the filing, or only by the time the judge rules (open point o15); the message follows the protective reading, obtaining it before filing.

message.ar: المادة 8 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: تقدم الوثائق باللغة العربية أو مصحوبة بترجمة رسمية إليها، تحت طائلة عدم القبول. تحقق من إرفاق ترجمة رسمية بكل وثيقة محررة بلغة أجنبية.
message.en: Article 8 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: documents are filed in Arabic or with an official translation, on pain of inadmissibility. Check that every document in a foreign language carries an official translation.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: The sanction falls on the untranslated document; whether it reaches the claim itself depends on whether the claim rests on that document, which the text does not settle.

message.ar: المادة 17 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب إشهار عريضة الدعوى لدى المحافظة العقارية إذا تعلقت بعقار أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر، وتقديمها في أول جلسة، تحت طائلة عدم قبولها شكلا، ما لم يثبت إيداعها للإشهار. يحتمل النص قراءتين: أن الواجب يقتصر على العقار أو الحق المشهر، أو أنه يشمل كل عقار. تحقق من وضع العقار ومن إشهار العريضة أو إيداعها للإشهار.
message.en: Article 17 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: a petition concerning real property or a real right published under the law must be published at the land registry and produced at the first hearing, on pain of inadmissibility in form, unless its deposit for publication is proved. The text bears two readings: the duty reaches only published property or rights, or any real property. Check the property's status and that the petition is published or deposited for publication.

priorSteps.interpretiveNote: Whether «مشهر» qualifies the property as well as the real right is not settled by the Arabic; the protective reading applies the duty to every claim on real property. The petition can only be published once it is written, and the text lets the plaintiff produce it at the first hearing or prove its deposit, so a missing publication at the drafting stage warns and never blocks.

label.ar: محضر عدم الصلح المحرر إثر محاولة الصلح أمام القاضي المعين من رئيس المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة
label.en: The record of non-conciliation drawn up after the conciliation before the judge appointed by the president of the specialised commercial court

message.ar: المادة 536 مكرر 4 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يسبق قيد الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة إجراء الصلح، وفي حالة فشله ترفع الدعوى بعريضة افتتاح دعوى مرفقة بمحضر عدم الصلح، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا. تحقق من إجراء الصلح ومن إرفاق محضر عدم الصلح بالعريضة.
message.en: Article 536 bis 4 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: registration of a claim before the specialised commercial court is preceded by a conciliation; when it fails, the claim is brought by an opening petition accompanied by the record of non-conciliation, on pain of the claim being inadmissible in form. Check that the conciliation was held and that the record of non-conciliation is attached.

message.ar: المادة 8 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: يجب أن تتم الإجراءات والعقود القضائية من عرائض ومذكرات باللغة العربية، تحت طائلة عدم القبول. تحقق من أن العريضة محررة كلها باللغة العربية.
message.en: Article 8 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: judicial procedures and acts, petitions and briefs included, must be in Arabic, on pain of inadmissibility. Check that the whole petition is written in Arabic.

looksLike.ar: عريضة افتتاح دعوى عادية أمام المحكمة
looksLike.en: An ordinary opening petition before the court

tellingFacts.ar: الدعوى ترمي إلى إلغاء قرار إداري أو تفسيره أو فحص مشروعيته.
tellingFacts.en: The claim seeks to annul, interpret or review the legality of an administrative decision.

message.ar: المادتان 816 و819 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: عريضة الدعوى أمام المحكمة الإدارية تتضمن بيانات العريضة العادية، ويجب أن يرفق بها القرار الإداري المطعون فيه تحت طائلة عدم القبول ما لم يوجد مانع مبرر. تحقق من الجهة القضائية ومن المرفقات.
message.en: Articles 816 and 819 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: a petition before the administrative court carries the ordinary particulars, and the contested administrative decision must be attached, on pain of inadmissibility, unless there is a justified impediment. Check the court and the attachments.

looksLike.en: A divorce petition brought by a single spouse

tellingFacts.ar: الزوجان متفقان على الطلاق وتوابعه ويقدمان طلبا مشتركا.
tellingFacts.en: Both spouses agree on the divorce and its consequences and file a joint request.

message.ar: المادتان 428 و429 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: الطلاق بالتراضي يقدم بطلب مشترك في شكل عريضة وحيدة موقعة من الزوجين تودع بأمانة الضبط، لها بياناتها ومرفقاتها الخاصة. تحقق من أن العريضة مشتركة وموقعة من الزوجين معا.
message.en: Articles 428 and 429 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: divorce by mutual consent is requested jointly by a single petition signed by both spouses and filed at the registry, with its own particulars and attachments. Check that the petition is joint and signed by both spouses.

looksLike.en: A joint petition for divorce by mutual consent

tellingFacts.ar: اختلال في القدرات الذهنية يمنعه من التعبير عن إرادته، يثبته طبيب مختص
tellingFacts.en: A mental impairment prevents him from expressing his will, established by a specialist doctor

message.ar: المادة 432 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية: لا يجوز تقديم طلب الطلاق بالتراضي إذا كان أحد الزوجين تحت التقديم أو ظهر عليه اختلال في قدراته الذهنية يمنعه من التعبير عن إرادته، ويجب إثبات اختلال القدرات الذهنية من قبل طبيب مختص. تحقق من حالة الزوجين، ومن الشهادة الطبية إذا كان السبب اختلالا ذهنيا.
message.en: Article 432 of the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure: a request for divorce by mutual consent may not be made where a spouse is under curatorship or shows a mental impairment that prevents him from expressing his will, and the impairment must be established by a specialist doctor. Check the spouses' situation, and the medical certificate when the ground is a mental impairment.

examples.title: Clean case: natural persons of full capacity, every particular stated, no authorisation needed, Arabic documents, ordinary claim. (Corrected: the particulars of article 15 and the other facts the reconciled steps read are now given; the verifier added the petition's language and the specialised commercial court.)
Every step done: legal person with its particulars, minor through his guardian, authorisation obtained, documents translated. (Corrected: the other particulars are given.)
Every step missing: blocks for the legal person's particulars and the unrepresented minor; warnings for the authorisation and the translation.
Nothing known: every item asks for its triggering fact or its own slot. (Corrected: the questions of the steps derivation B found are added, and those of the verifier's steps p18 and p19.)
Triggering facts known, steps unknown: each step asks for its own slot. (Extended to the representative, the land-registry publication and the record of non-conciliation.)
Claim against an administrative decision: the administrative petition's own rules are flagged.
Legal person whose particulars are not stated, other facts clean: the block stands alone.
Divorce petition by a single spouse of full capacity: no step fires; the copy for the defendant and the prosecution is a listed document.
A company sues for unpaid invoices and the petition omits its registered seat and its representative's capacity.
Near miss: no party is a legal person, so the legal-person particulars are not required even though the answer is no.
The defendant's domicile is left out of the draft.
Fees not paid and no exemption: a warning.
Fees not paid but the plaintiff has legal aid: the exemption applies.
Fees not paid and the exemption is not known: the rule asks.
The plaintiff has no standing against this defendant and no interest.

A minor sues without his legal representative. (Corrected: a party lacking capacity who is not represented blocks under articles 64 and 65; derivation B expected a warning, and its representative step now covers agents only.)
A claim that needs an authorisation which has not been obtained.
A foreign-language contract is attached without an official translation.
A divorce petition not yet served on the defendant and the public prosecutor. (Corrected: service follows registration, so no prior step warns; the copy is listed.)
A joint petition for divorce by consent while a spouse is under curatorship.
A petition not signed, no copies for the parties, no reference to the documents.
Claim on published real property, the petition not yet published or deposited: a warning, never a block (x4).
Claim on real property that is not itself published, publication of the petition not stated: the protective reading asks (x4, bc3).
Claim not about real property: no publication duty (x4, bc2).
The defendant is a minor and the petition names no legal representative for him: the rule reaches every party, not only the plaintiff (x52).
The petition gives no statement of facts, requests and grounds: a particular of article 15 (x47).
The court is not named and a required authorisation is missing: the article 15 particular blocks, the authorisation warns (x59, x60).
An agent files without a valid power of attorney: a warning (x53).
A bank sues a merchant for an unpaid credit before an installed specialised commercial court, and no record of non-conciliation is attached: the petition's own sanction blocks (adv-1).
The same bank claim with the record of non-conciliation attached: the step is done (adv-1).
A divorce drafted as one spouse's petition although both spouses consent: the joint single petition of article 428 is flagged (atk-3).
The petition is drafted in French: article 8 paragraph 1 blocks the clean export (atk-8).
A joint petition for divorce by consent where a specialist doctor has established one spouse's mental impairment: the bar of article 432 warns, its message naming the doctor's proof (atk-9).
A maintenance claim, fees not paid, exemption not stated: the rule asks whether legal aid (as of right included) applies, and does not warn (adv-3).
A maintenance claim whose plaintiff has legal aid as of right, fees not paid: the exemption applies (adv-3).
A claim to annul an administrative decision: the boundary warns on articles 816 and 819 only, nothing about a lawyer's signature, since Law 22-13 rewrote article 815 and repealed article 826 (adv-2).
The defendant is an adult of unsound mind (imbecility, one of the causes Family Code article 81 names) and the petition names no curator for him: the representation step blocks (sup-42).

A childless couple drafts one spouse's divorce petition although both consent: the joint single petition is flagged, its number of minor children being required only where applicable, and the family certificate and marriage extract are listed (sup-81).

question.ar: ما جزاء عريضة غير موقعة أو غير مؤرخة أو لم تودع بعدد النسخ المطلوب؟
question.en: What is the sanction of a petition that is not signed, not dated, or not filed in the required number of copies?

why.ar: تشترط المادة 14 التوقيع والتاريخ والنسخ دون جزاء صريح، وجزاء عدم القبول شكلا في المادة 15 يتعلق بالبيانات المعددة فيها، والمادة 60 لا تقرر البطلان الشكلي إلا بنص.
why.en: Article 14 requires a signature, a date and copies and states no sanction; the formal inadmissibility of article 15 attaches to the particulars it lists; article 60 allows no nullity for form without a text.

reading.ar: العريضة غير الموقعة أو غير المؤرخة ليست العريضة التي تشترطها المادة 14، فهي غير مقبولة.
reading.en: An unsigned or undated petition is not the petition article 14 requires, and is inadmissible.

reading.ar: لا جزاء دون نص صريح، ويمكن التصحيح أثناء الخصومة.
reading.en: No sanction without an express text; the defect can be corrected during the proceedings.

protectiveReading.ar: اعتبار التوقيع والتاريخ والنسخ لازمة والتنبيه إلى غيابها دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Treat the signature, the date and the copies as required and warn when they are missing, without blocking.

question.ar: متى يشترط القانون إذنا لرفع الدعوى، وما جزاء غيابه؟
question.en: When does the law require an authorisation to sue, and what does its absence cost?

why.ar: المادة 13 تحيل إلى القانون دون تعداد ولا تذكر جزاء صريحا. المادة 88 من قانون الأسرة تشترط إذن القاضي للولي في قسمة عقار القاصر والمصالحة، ولا تذكر رفع الدعوى صراحة.
why.en: Article 13 refers to the law without a list and states no express sanction. Family Code article 88 requires the judge's permission for a guardian to partition the minor's real property or to settle, without naming the bringing of a claim.

reading.ar: انعدام الإذن يجعل الدعوى غير مقبولة لأنه من شروط قبولها.
reading.en: Without the authorisation the claim is inadmissible, the authorisation being a condition of admissibility.

reading.ar: الإذن شرط لصحة التصرف لا لقبول الدعوى، إلا حيث ينص القانون على ذلك صراحة.
reading.en: The authorisation conditions the validity of the act, not the admissibility of the claim, unless a law says so expressly.

protectiveReading.ar: السؤال عن ضرورة الإذن، والتنبيه دون منع التصدير عند غيابه.
protectiveReading.en: Ask whether an authorisation is required, and warn without blocking when it is missing.

question.ar: هل يمتد جزاء عدم قبول الوثيقة غير المترجمة إلى الدعوى نفسها؟
question.en: Does the inadmissibility of an untranslated document reach the claim itself?

why.ar: الفقرة الثانية من المادة 8 تجعل الوثيقة غير المترجمة غير مقبولة، ولا تتناول أثر ذلك على الطلب.
why.en: The second paragraph of article 8 makes the untranslated document inadmissible and is silent on the effect on the claim.

reading.ar: تستبعد الوثيقة وحدها وتبقى الدعوى قائمة على باقي الأدلة.
reading.en: Only the document is excluded; the claim stands on the remaining evidence.

reading.ar: إذا كانت الدعوى قائمة على الوثيقة فقد يؤدي استبعادها إلى عدم قبول الطلب أو رفضه.
reading.en: Where the claim rests on that document, its exclusion may make the claim inadmissible or unfounded.

question.ar: هل يثير القاضي تلقائيا عدم قبول العريضة شكلا لنقص بيان من بياناتها، وهل يمكن تداركه أثناء الخصومة؟
question.en: Does the judge raise of his own motion the formal inadmissibility of a petition lacking a particular, and can it be made good during the proceedings?

why.ar: المادة 15 تقرر الجزاء دون أن تحدد من يثيره ولا هل يمكن التدارك. المادة 69 توجب الإثارة التلقائية لعدم القبول المتعلق بالنظام العام دون تعداد حالاته، والمادتان 62 و66 تتعلقان بالبطلان لا بعدم القبول، والمادة 50 تتعلق بالدفوع الشكلية.
why.en: Article 15 states the sanction without saying who raises it or whether it can be made good. Article 69 requires the judge to raise inadmissibility of public order without listing its cases; articles 62 and 66 concern nullity, not inadmissibility; article 50 concerns procedural pleas.

reading.ar: عدم القبول شكلا يثيره القاضي تلقائيا ولا يتدارك.
reading.en: The formal inadmissibility is raised by the judge of his own motion and cannot be made good.

reading.ar: لا يثار إلا بدفع من الخصم، ويمكن تداركه قياسا على تصحيح الإجراء الباطل.
reading.en: It is raised only on the opponent's plea, and can be made good by analogy with the correction of a void act.

protectiveReading.ar: اعتبار كل بيان من بيانات المادة 15 لازما قبل التصدير النظيف.
protectiveReading.en: Treat every particular of article 15 as required before the clean export.

question.ar: ما مقادير الرسوم القضائية وحالات الإعفاء منها وشروط المساعدة القضائية؟
question.en: What are the amounts of the judicial fees, the statutory exemptions, and the conditions of legal aid?

why.ar: تحيل المادتان 17 و418 إلى التشريع، ونصوص الرسوم غير موجودة في مخزن النصوص، وكذلك الأمر المتعلق بالمساعدة القضائية؛ وقد وجدت المادة 28 منه في الجريدة الرسمية وطلبت (النقطة المفتوحة o14).
why.en: Articles 17 and 418 refer to legislation; the fee texts are not in the article store, nor is the legal-aid ordinance; its article 28 was found in the Official Journal and requested (open point o14).

protectiveReading.ar: السؤال عن الإعفاء دون افتراضه، وإدراج وصل الرسوم أو ما يثبت الإعفاء ضمن الوثائق دون حكم على المقدار.
protectiveReading.en: Ask about the exemption and never assume it; list the fee receipt or proof of exemption, without ruling on any amount.

question.ar: ما سن الرشد وسن التمييز ومن هو فاقد الأهلية وناقصها؟
question.en: What are the ages of majority and of discernment, and who lacks or has diminished capacity?

why.ar: تحيل مواد قانون الأسرة إلى مواد القانون المدني في الأهلية، وهي غير موجودة في مخزن النصوص.
why.en: The Family Code refers to the Civil Code articles on capacity, which are not in the article store.

protectiveReading.ar: ترك تقدير الأهلية للمحامي عبر السؤال دون افتراضها.
protectiveReading.en: Leave the assessment of capacity to the lawyer through the question, and never assume it.

question.ar: هل يجب أن تذكر عريضة دعوى الأسرة النيابة العامة طرفا فيها؟
question.en: Must a family-matter petition name the public prosecution as a party?

why.ar: المادة 3 مكرر من قانون الأسرة تجعل النيابة العامة طرفا أصليا في قضايا الأسرة، ولا يذكر قانون الإجراءات ذلك ضمن بيانات العريضة؛ والمادة 438 توجب تبليغها بعريضة الطلاق فقط.
why.en: Family Code article 3 bis makes the public prosecution a principal party in family cases; the procedure code does not list it among the petition's particulars, and article 438 requires service of the divorce petition on it only.

reading.ar: تذكر النيابة العامة طرفا في كل عريضة لدعوى أسرية.
reading.en: The prosecution is named as a party in every family petition.

reading.ar: يكفي تبليغها حيث ينص القانون، كما في دعوى الطلاق.
reading.en: Serving it where a text requires, as in divorce, is enough.

protectiveReading.ar: إدراج نسخة للنيابة العامة في دعاوى الطلاق، وتنبيه المحامي إلى صفتها طرفا أصليا في قضايا الأسرة.
protectiveReading.en: List a copy for the prosecution in divorce claims, and remind the lawyer that it is a principal party in family cases.

question.ar: ما أثر عدم دفع الرسوم عند الإيداع؟
question.en: What is the effect of non-payment of the fees at the filing?

why.ar: المادة 17 تمنع القيد دون الرسوم ولا تقول إن العريضة غير مقبولة.
why.en: Article 17 bars registration without the fees and does not say the petition is inadmissible.

reading.ar: لا تقيد العريضة ويمكن دفع الرسوم ثم قيدها.
reading.en: The petition is not registered and can be registered once the fees are paid.

reading.ar: يفصل رئيس الجهة القضائية في النزاع حول الرسوم بأمر غير قابل للطعن.
reading.en: A dispute over the fees is decided by the president of the court by an order open to no remedy.

protectiveReading.en: Warn only, without blocking the export.

question.ar: هل يقتصر واجب إشهار العريضة على العقار أو الحق العيني المشهر، وهل يسأل عنه عند التحرير؟
question.en: Is the duty to publish the petition limited to published property or rights, and is it a question at the drafting stage?

why.ar: عبارة «بعقار و/أو حق عيني عقاري مشهر» تحتمل أن تتعلق كلمة «مشهر» بالحق وحده أو بالعقار والحق معا؛ والإشهار لا يتم إلا بعد تحرير العريضة، والنص يكتفي بتقديمها في أول جلسة أو بإثبات إيداعها.
